item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump to allow more beef imports as some Republicans warn it could hurt ranchers
item.description: President Donald Trump announced that his administration will allow more beef to be temporarily imported into the U.S. without triggering higher tariffs.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Madeira Beach Burger Week serving up culinary journey with 18 unique burgers
item.description: Chefs from 18 restaurants will be preparing unique takes on the classic burger. There will be a pizza burger, pizza tacos, French onion burger, and so much more.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rowdies Hilton quietly rewrites history
item.description: Lewis Hilton, a seven-year veteran with Tampa Bay, has become a cornerstone of a Rowdies team steamrolling through the regular season. His 175 appearances are second-most in franchise history.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Citrus County man sentenced for shooting at utility workers restoring power
item.description: A Citrus County man was sentenced Friday to prison after prosecutors said he fired multiple shots at utility workers who were attempting to restore power during a 2025 outage call.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 2 arrested after $1.5M scam of Treasure Island resident's jewelry, precious metals: Police
item.description: Treasure Island police arrested two people after investigators say a sophisticated phone scam led to the theft of approximately $1.5 million in jewelry and precious metals from an older resident.
